io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.items.recipebook

Class RecipeBook

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.api.items.BaseSTBItem
      • io.github.thebusybiscuit.sensibletoolbox.items.recipebook.RecipeBook
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    InventoryGUIListener, io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.libraries.keys.Keyed, java.lang.Comparable<BaseSTBItem>
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    AdvancedRecipeBook

    public class RecipeBook
extends BaseSTBItem
    A recipe book allows browsing of all known recipes, and also fabrication of items. Player permissions are taken into account; the player must have the stb.craft.{item-name} permission node to see the item in the recipe book.

      • setMatchProviders

        protected void setMatchProviders(java.lang.String... pluginNames)
        Set a list of STB item provider plugin names to filter the list of matched items by. Plugins can extend this class and override this method if they want to create a custom recipe book which only includes recipes provided by them.

        The plugin names should be strings, as returned by Plugin.getName(). Passing an empty array of plugin names clears the filter.

        Parameters:
        pluginNames - zero or more provider plugin names
